'''Skull Leader''', or '''Skull One''', was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by [[Gunn Yage]] when she led [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]], an elite [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
